In this video, I’m running the massive Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 125B model locally on an Apple M5 Max with 128GB unified memory and comparing two inference approaches: MLX/oMLX and GGUF with llama.cpp.

The results are surprisingly different.

With Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-oQ4e-mtp running on oMLX 0.6.3 with Lightning MTP, I’m getting around 60 tokens/sec during generation.
